text:
devon: ok this is peak WFH chaos — a squirrel literally climbed onto my patio table and walked off with my headset during standup. not kidding. https://imgur.com/a/placeholder :squirrel: :headphones:
jamal: omg nooooo :joy: did it run into the neighbour's yard?
sophia: this is the sort of thing I expect in a nature doc, not my coworker's Zoom feed. picture? :eyes:
devon: posted one in thread — it's tiny but determined. looked like it wanted to try noise cancellation.
leo: pro tip: if it chews the mic, file a claim under "act of nature"? :stuck_out_tongue:
devon: @jamal called a heroic retrieval mission involving trail mix and a cookie crumb trail. currently unarmed.
emma: bless your brave heart. otherwise use `bluetoothctl` to pair a backup? or duct tape to a spoon as impulsive interim mic. :laughing:
jamal: i volunteer as distraction. will bring banana. :banana: (jk unless permissions approved)
ops-bot: INCIDENT LOGGED: #WFH-ODDITY-402 — "Squirrel Headset Heist" assigned to devon. ETA for follow-up: 24h.
sophia: poll: ransom or let it go? react with :one: for reclaim, :two: for surrender to the wild.
leo: also, anyone got spare wired buds i can borrow? my UPS just did a thing and i'm on hotspot so audio is messy.
emma: i have an extra pair in the office stash but shipping timeline is meh. could drop a pair at your doorstep if you're close.
devon: update: the squirrel dropped the headset on the neighbor's shed. jamal and i executed a stealthy retrieval (and bribed with a stale muffin). mission accomplished. :tada:
jamal: photographic evidence or it didn't happen — attaching a blurry victory selfie. :camera_with_flash:
sophia: finest morning. can we get a small ficus named in honor of the hero squirrel?
leo: adding to team rituals: every time a small animal steals gear, we add a line to the "WFH survival tips" doc.
emma: next training: how to politely negotiate with wildlife. 2pm optional slack huddle. :calendar:
devon: thanks for the help y'all. headset seems fine, mic slightly chewed but still usable. ordering a replacement anyway.
jamal: also — can we add a checkbox in the return-to-office checklist: "secure snacks"?
sophia: yes. also consider: move snacks off desk during standups, or do standups in bunker.
leo: official Slack reaction summary: :thumbsup: 9, :joy: 12, :squirrel: 7.
ops-bot: REMINDER: file expense for replacement headset if needed. use code WFH-TOOLS.
devon: will do.
